notes: Source of truth for every generated image. `prompt` is the scene description; the generation script appends `styleGuide` and records the exact text sent, model, date, dimensions and token usage under `generation`. Status: planned → generated | failed. Nothing is generated without explicit approval; the script only runs the asset IDs or batch it is given.

styleGuide: Photographic style: editorial architectural photography for a printed monograph, as if shot on a medium-format digital camera with a tilt-shift lens. Natural daylight only, soft realistic shadows and gentle falloff, accurate warm-neutral white balance, true-to-life material textures with subtle natural imperfections, restrained and uncluttered styling, perfectly straight vertical lines, realistic architectural proportions and believable construction details. Colour palette of warm limestone, charcoal, natural stone and muted olive-grey. Strictly avoid: people, text, lettering, signage, logos, watermarks, borders or frames, CGI or 3D-render appearance, glossy plastic surfaces, HDR, oversaturation, lens flare, distorted or floating furniture, impossible geometry, inconsistent window and door proportions.

assets.purpose: Primary brand image and likely LCP element. Must read as architecture immediately, with calm negative space.
assets.alt: The walled inner court of the Courtyard House in late afternoon: pale limestone walls, a shallow reflecting pool and a single olive tree before an oak-framed loggia.
assets.prompt: A wide view across the inner courtyard of a contemporary single-storey house built from pale honed limestone. Low, thick stone walls enclose a calm square court with a shallow rectangular reflecting pool and a single mature olive tree growing from a bed of pale gravel. On the far side a deep, thin flat roof overhang shelters a loggia with floor-to-ceiling glazing set in slim oiled-oak frames. Late-afternoon sun rakes across the stone and casts long, soft shadows; the sky is clear and pale. Camera at standing eye height, centred and symmetrical composition, generous quiet space above the walls.

assets.purpose: Material close-up. Tests texture realism and colour fidelity in the pilot batch.
assets.alt: Close-up of a honed limestone wall in long, low courses meeting a stone floor at a crisp shadow gap, grazed by warm low sunlight.
assets.prompt: Close-up of a honed pale limestone wall built in long, low courses with fine joints, meeting a limestone floor at a crisp recessed shadow gap. Warm low sunlight grazes the surface from the side, revealing natural fossil texture and subtle variations of colour. Abstract, calm composition with the courses running horizontally.

assets.purpose: Shows the practice's working method (physical models) without people or legible drawings.
assets.alt: A white plaster massing model of a low courtyard house on an oiled oak table, lit by soft north light from a tall window.
assets.prompt: A carefully made white plaster architectural massing model of a low courtyard house resting on a long oiled-oak worktable in a quiet design studio. Soft north light from a tall window at the left falls across the model, revealing its walls and openings through delicate shadows. Behind it, slightly out of focus, a warm lime-plastered wall and a few rolled sheets of plain blank paper. Close, low three-quarter view with shallow depth of field.

assets.alt: Detail of oiled rift-sawn oak joinery: a flush cabinet door with a recessed finger pull and a slim shadow gap.
assets.prompt: Close-up detail of oiled rift-sawn oak joinery: a flush cabinet door with a precise recessed finger pull and a slim, even shadow gap to the adjacent panel. Straight, even grain and a matte finish, softly lit from the side by a nearby window.

assets.purpose: Material close-up showing how plaster carries light.
assets.alt: A softly curved wall in warm off-white lime plaster, washed by daylight in a smooth gradient from light to shadow.
assets.prompt: A softly curved interior wall finished in warm off-white lime plaster with a gentle hand-trowelled texture. Daylight from an unseen window washes across it, creating a smooth gradient from light into shadow around the curve. Minimal, abstract composition.

assets.alt: Board-formed concrete wall bearing the imprint of horizontal timber boards and a regular grid of tie holes, lit by grazing daylight.
assets.prompt: Close-up of a board-formed concrete wall with the clear imprint of horizontal timber boards, small tie holes in a regular grid and soft daylight grazing across it from above. Neutral grey with warm undertones, matte and finely detailed.

assets.purpose: Project hero and card image: the house in its landscape.
assets.alt: The Courtyard House in a dry landscape of grasses and olive trees: long, low limestone walls beneath a thin flat roof with a deep overhang.
assets.prompt: Exterior of a contemporary single-storey courtyard house in a dry, gently sloping Mediterranean landscape of wild grasses, rosemary and a few olive trees. Long horizontal walls of pale honed limestone with only a few deep-set openings, a thin flat roof with a generous overhang and a recessed entrance door in oiled oak. Clear morning light, soft shadows, pale blue sky. Low eye-level two-point perspective with straight verticals, the house stretching across the frame.

assets.purpose: Interior view connecting living room and court.
assets.alt: Living room of the Courtyard House with limestone walls, a wide oak floor and a low linen sofa, opening to a sunlit court with an olive tree.
assets.prompt: Interior of the living room of a limestone courtyard house: pale honed limestone walls, a wide-plank oiled-oak floor, a low linen sofa in a natural tone and a simple oak bench. A large opening framed in slim oak looks onto a sunlit courtyard with an olive tree. Deep window reveals and a smooth lime-plaster ceiling. Afternoon light enters from the side and casts a long, soft shadow across the floor. Calm and uncluttered.

assets.alt: A long living space in the Atelier Apartment: lime-plaster walls, a wide oak floor, tall windows with oak seats and a full-height oak joinery wall.
assets.prompt: Interior of a renovated top-floor apartment in a 1930s city building: a long, calm living space with warm white lime-plaster walls, a wide-board oiled-oak floor and tall original windows set in deep walls with built-in oak window seats. Along one side runs a continuous floor-to-ceiling oak joinery wall with flush doors. A slender blackened-steel glazed screen divides the space. Minimal furniture: a low linen sofa, a round oak table and a single ceramic vase. Soft morning daylight.

assets.purpose: Detail of the oak joinery spine and kitchen.
assets.alt: Kitchen set into a full-height wall of oiled oak joinery, with a thick honed stone worktop and a single stone shelf of ceramic bowls.
assets.prompt: A kitchen built into a floor-to-ceiling wall of oiled rift-sawn oak joinery in a renovated apartment. A thick honed pale stone worktop with an integrated sink and a slim brushed-steel tap, and a single stone shelf holding a few handmade ceramic bowls. Warm white lime-plaster wall and ceiling. Daylight from a tall window at the right. Straight-on composition, calm and precise.

assets.alt: A curved lime-plaster wall leading along a quiet passage, with a recessed niche holding a single stoneware vessel.
assets.prompt: A softly curved lime-plaster wall guiding a quiet passage towards the bedrooms of a renovated apartment. A shallow recessed niche in the wall holds a single stoneware vessel. Oiled oak floor, a tall oak door standing slightly open, daylight from a window just out of frame creating gentle gradients of light along the curve.

assets.alt: The lounge of Hotel Calcare inside a restored stone workshop: rough limestone walls, chestnut beams, a travertine fireplace and low linen sofas.
assets.prompt: The lounge of a small boutique hotel inside a restored nineteenth-century stone workshop: thick, roughly dressed limestone walls, a high ceiling with exposed chestnut timber beams, a monolithic travertine fireplace, low linen sofas and oak lounge chairs on a honed travertine floor. Tall arched openings with slim steel-framed glazing look out onto a garden. Warm late-morning daylight, quiet and refined, no people.

assets.alt: A guest room at Hotel Calcare: limewashed stone walls, a low oak bed in natural linen with a travertine bench at its foot, and a deep window hung with linen curtains.
assets.prompt: A guest room in a boutique hotel within an old stone building: limewashed walls, a low oak bed with natural linen bedding, a travertine bench at the foot of the bed, a deep window set into a thick stone wall with simple linen curtains, and wide oak floorboards. Soft afternoon light and a calm atmosphere.

assets.alt: A bathroom lined in honed travertine with a monolithic stone basin and a small deep-set window admitting soft daylight.
assets.prompt: A hotel bathroom finished entirely in honed travertine: a monolithic travertine washbasin carved from a single block, a slim brushed-bronze wall-mounted tap, a small window with a deep reveal admitting soft daylight, and a natural linen towel on a simple oak rail. Serene, tactile and precise.

assets.alt: The Reading Pavilion at the edge of a garden: a low board-formed concrete volume with a long larch-framed window beneath a thin roof.
assets.prompt: A small public reading pavilion at the edge of a landscaped garden: a low, elongated board-formed concrete structure with a thin flat roof and one long horizontal window of clear glass framed in larch timber, with a larch-clad soffit visible under the roof overhang. Mature trees and meadow planting around it and a gravel path leading to the entrance. Soft, bright afternoon light, straight verticals, eye-level view.

assets.alt: Inside the Reading Pavilion: board-formed concrete walls, a long oak reading table with oak chairs, built-in oak bookshelves and a tall window to the garden, with daylight washing down from a high clerestory.
assets.prompt: Interior of a small public reading pavilion: board-formed concrete walls, a long solid oak reading table with simple oak chairs, built-in oak shelves holding books in plain linen bindings with no visible titles, and a long low window framing a garden. A high clerestory slot lets daylight wash down the concrete wall. Calm, quiet and empty of people.

assets.alt: The Reading Pavilion at dusk seen across tall meadow grasses, its long window glowing warmly beneath a deep blue sky.
assets.prompt: A small reading pavilion seen at dusk across a meadow of tall grasses: a low board-formed concrete volume with a warm glow from its long horizontal window, a larch soffit catching the last light and a few mature trees in silhouette against a deep blue evening sky. Calm, atmospheric, realistic low-light photography.

video.recommendation: Not recommended for launch. The static hero is the LCP element; a video would add weight and decoding cost for a modest gain. Generate only if explicitly approved.
video.modelVerification: models.get returned displayName "Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash" (generateContent); video output is requested through the Interactions API per the @google/genai SDK types. Not yet exercised live.
video.placement: Homepage hero, desktop only, layered over the static poster after load. Not requested on small screens, with Save-Data, or with reduced motion.
video.pricingNote: About $0.10 per second of 720p output (5,792 tokens/s at $17.50 per 1M video tokens), from third-party reports; unverified. 1080p pricing unconfirmed.
video.optimisationPlan: Strip audio, re-encode to H.264 at ~2.5 Mbps for a ~2 MB file, loop muted with playsinline, preload=none, poster from the hero image.
video.prompt: A locked-off camera looks across the walled limestone courtyard of a contemporary single-storey house in late afternoon. Over six seconds the low sun's shadows lengthen slowly across the pale honed stone, the leaves of a single olive tree stir in a light breeze and the surface of a shallow reflecting pool shimmers faintly. No camera movement, no people, no text. Realistic architectural film with soft natural light, muted warm palette of limestone, charcoal and olive-grey. Natural ambient sound only.
